# UVic Online Academic Community

> > A collaborative digital platform hosting University of Victoria student projects, research initiatives, and course portfolios spanning sustainability, digital humanities, network engineering, and experimental archaeology.

This site serves as a showcase for diverse academic work at the University of Victoria, featuring student portfolios, course materials, research projects from labs like PANLAB, and community initiatives such as the Race to Zero 2030 sustainability program. It demonstrates the intersection of traditional scholarship with digital tools and practice-based learning.

## Key Topics

- University of Victoria (UVic)
- digital-tools
- design-thinking
- visual-literacies

## Sustainability & Community Initiatives

- [Sustainability Food Index and Recipes](https://onlineacademiccommunity.uvic.ca/sustainabilityfood): UVic Race to Zero 2030 sustainability initiative with SNRF collaboration

## Digital Tools & Visual Research

- [Digital Tools – Dennine Dudley, Instructor](https://onlineacademiccommunity.uvic.ca/ahvs310cs25): AHVS310C course on digital tools & visual literacies by Dennine Dudley

## Network Engineering & Research

- [QUIC & MPQUIC @ PANLAB](https://onlineacademiccommunity.uvic.ca/quic): PANLAB research on QUIC/MPQUIC multipath protocols & network performance

## Student Portfolios

- [Izze Perrella's Design Thinking Portfolio](https://onlineacademiccommunity.uvic.ca/izzeperrellaportfolio): Student design portfolio showcasing Izze Perrella's UVIC projects

## Historical & Archaeological Projects

- [Pen to Paper; Recreating Ink and Paper of the Medieval Era](https://onlineacademiccommunity.uvic.ca/anth361scribesscript): Medieval manuscript recreation project by Ben & Alex on parchment/inks
- [HMCS Rainbow History](https://onlineacademiccommunity.uvic.ca/hmcsrainbowhistory): HMCS Rainbow Canadian naval history project covering WWI era
